main.description: Client settings that follow the user across devices. Every field is optional and a client applies its own default for an absent one.

theme.description: The color theme. system follows the operating system.

messagePreviews.description: Whether the channel list shows the latest message under each channel name.

linkEmbedsByDefault.description: Whether a link in a new message gets a preview by default.

warnOnExternalLinks.description: Whether opening a link to another site asks for confirmation first.

blueskyClient.description: The client that Bluesky posts and profiles open in.

customBlueskyClientBase.description: The domain of the client used when blueskyClient is custom.

developerMode.description: Whether the client shows identifiers and links to inspect records.

experiments.description: The experiments the user turned on.
